resources.string: A new chat starts before this message and sends it again. This chat stays as it is. Files on the Mac are not rewound.
A new chat starts before this message with the message in the composer. This chat stays as it is. Files on the Mac are not rewound.
Stop the chat before rewinding it.
The new chat started, but the message could not be sent again. Send it from the composer.
Attachments are not carried over. Add them again if you need them.
The new chat started, but the host could not confirm whether the message was sent again. Wait for the reply before sending anything.
